questions.question: Why did Israel lose the first battle at Ai?
options: A sudden storm scattered their forces in the hills
Their army was far too small and weak to win
Their weapons were old and very poorly made
Achan had taken devoted things (forbidden plunder)
questions.answer: Achan had taken devoted things (forbidden plunder)

questions.question: What happened to Achan and his family?
options: They were pardoned after they confessed
They were sent away into exile
They fled and were never found

questions.question: God told Joshua that Israel had sinned and taken what was devoted to destruction.
_____ took a robe, silver, and gold that had been devoted to destruction.
Because of the hidden sin, Israel was defeated at _____.
